function.name: dispute_transaction
function.description: Opens a dispute on a verified customer's card charge that was wrong: charged twice, wrong amount, never received, or charged after cancelling. Not for charges the customer did not make (that is fraud: block the card instead). Pass the transaction reference from get_transactions, the reason in the caller's words, and confirmed. Only after the caller clearly says yes, set confirmed to yes.

security_answer.description: The security answer the caller gave when verifying

reference.description: The transaction reference from get_transactions, like T1000531

reason.description: What went wrong, in the caller's words. Leave out if not known yet.

confirmed.description: yes only if the caller clearly said yes to disputing this exact charge. Otherwise leave out.
